replay.note: the advocates' outputs were replayed from an earlier run and not regenerated by this one: only the judge was called, so the figures here measure the judge's behaviour on fixed inputs and not the whole pipeline

ruling.explanation:
Both of you: this dispute is decided on the driver's own GPS trace, and on that trace the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee was not earned.

What happened, on the unimpaired evidence. The driver accepted at 19:35:10 and reached the pickup pin at Blk 267 Tampines St 21 — EV-GPS-00203 (weight 1.0, 100% coverage, no gaps) shows 21 consecutive in-radius fixes at 5–11 m accuracy, the closest 18.7 m from the pin, well inside the 50 m STANDARD radius. The driver really did arrive at the pin; the rider's suggestion of a too-early cancel is not borne out on the geography, and the 'arrived' marker is not a false marker under POL-NS-05 — at the marker the driver was stationary at the pin, not moving at 15 km/h or more and not more than 300 m away.

But POL-NS-01 requires the driver to hold that position for a continuous 300-second dwell, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, and the trace measures the hold at 195 seconds — one unbroken run of 21 fixes from 19:41:20 to 19:44:35, a shortfall of 105 seconds. The driver cancelled at 19:44:40, about 100 seconds before the waiting period would have matured. Both sides accept this arithmetic, and it is the driver's own advocate who concedes it. Limb (c) of POL-NS-01 therefore fails, and limb (d) fails with it. Under POL-NS-06 the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full. POL-NS-03 does not apply: the driver was inside the arrival radius, not at the wrong face of the building.

The driver's two answers. (1) Accumulation: POL-NS-06(i) lets separate in-geofence intervals be summed only where a traffic advisory is present and populated with a qualifying type. There is only one interval here (run_count 1), and EV-ADVIS-00203-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT), so there is nothing to sum and no advisory to excuse the shortfall. (2) Rider exoneration under POL-NS-04: it does not carry this ruling, because the driver replied in chat 101 seconds after the rider's message — inside the clause's 120-second window — so limb (b) fails. Either way the refund is the same; POL-NS-06 does not depend on the rider's conduct.

No driver compensation. POL-NS-07 pays 80 percent only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and POL-NS-06 states expressly that where the dwell falls short of the minimum the full refund stands and no driver compensation is payable. The 20 percent retention the driver might otherwise have kept does not arise.

Weight of the evidence, for both of you. The chat log EV-CHAT-00203 is impaired at weight 0.85 (issue LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY — the rider's 'wait ah, i coming liao' is genuinely contestable between 'on my way' and 'already here'); both advocates disclosed that discount, and it does not touch the message timestamps, but nothing in this ruling needs the chat, so it does not lower confidence. The missing traffic advisory carries weight 0.0 and its absence is itself citable, as it is here. The deciding fact — the 195-second dwell — rests on the GPS trace alone, at weight 1.0, so confidence is not capped below the floor, and the chat impairment is a POL-GEN-02 confidence discount only, not a POL-NS-08 impairment (it engages none of limbs (a)–(d)).

No escalation. I checked every POL-NS-09 trigger: both profiles show no same-pair repeat disputes; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below 3; the driver's anti-farming figures (2 no-show terminations against 131 completed trips, rate 0.0153) do not trip; the admissible artifacts do not contradict one another on arrival, dwell or rider presence; and the deciding fact is carried by an unimpaired artifact. The case is decided, not held. No referral is produced by any clause: POL-NS-05(ii) requires a false arrival marker, and this was not one, and POL-NS-03(ii) requires a wrong-entrance case, and this was not one.

Result: FULL_REFUND of the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee. Only the cancellation-fee line is refunded — every other line on the fare breakdown is zero, and the charge reconciles with the fee schedule (STANDARD 4.00 and RYDE_X 4.00, greater-of = 4.00), so no fare-integrity issue arises.
